🎯 PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Analytical and detail-oriented Trade Lifecycle Operations Analyst with experience supporting Morgan Stanley's Fixed Income Operations. Skilled in trade confirmation, settlement, reconciliation, exception management, and break resolution, with hands-on expertise across DTCC, Euroclear, Bloomberg, RTTM, and Intellimatch. Strong ability to work in fast-paced global markets, collaborate with counterparties and custodians, and deliver timely, accurate post-trade processing while minimizing operational risk.

May, 2023 March, 2020 March, 2018

💼 EXPERIENCE

1. eClerx - Financial Analyst (eClerx provides specialized business process management, automation, and analytics services, primarily serving Fortune 2000 companies in financial services, digital marketing, cable & telecom, fashion, and retail. They help clients optimize operations, improve customer experiences, and manage data) Trade Confirmation • Executed trade confirmation and booking validation by matching trade details with counterparties via DTCC RTTM (Real Time Trade Matching) and verifying trade bookings in Legacy and BigMac, ensuring accuracy, consistency of trade economics, and timely settlement.

May 2025 - May 2026

Trade Settlement • Supported Middle Office operations for Morgan Stanley, managing the end-to-end trade lifecycle from confirmation to settlement while utilizing 7+ platforms—including DTCC (CTM/DTC), Euroclear, RTTM, Safeguard, Qwest, Intellimatch, and BigMac—to process 500+ Fixed Income derivative trades (OTC) daily, coordinate with settlement teams and custodians, and ensure timely T+1/T+2 settlements with zero processing errors.

Supported cross-border settlements through Euroclear, handling failed trades and ensuring timely resolution.

Exception Management • Conducted root cause analysis of aged breaks and liaised with broker-dealers, trading desks, custodians, and clients to resolve settlement breaks and manage exceptions, reduce trade fails, enhance settlement efficiency, and minimize operational risk. • Investigated and resolved Depot/Nostro, cash, and position breaks through trade reconciliation, validation of settlement instructions, and Bloomberg-assisted verification of net settlement amounts. • Collaborated with clients through periodic review calls to assess aged breaks, provide operational insights, and agree on corrective actions to reduce settlement exceptions and improve operational efficiency.

Account Reconciliation • Performed end-to-end reconciliation of aged Cost Center breaks, conducting root cause analysis and driving timely resolution of reconciliation exceptions. • Executed post-settlement journal entries to reconcile suspense accounts and maintain financial and accounting accuracy. • Coordinated DTCC broker-to-broker position transfers, reconciling position movements with clients to ensure accurate settlement records. • Investigated and resolved Security Payment Order (SPO) differences by reconciling payment discrepancies and coordinating recoveries through DTC and wire transfers.

Management Reporting • Produced comprehensive EOD MIS reports for 200+ daily Fixed Income transactions, reporting receivable/payable trade values, quantities, pending settlement breaks, and KRIs to senior management, enabling proactive escalations, effective settlement risk management, and timely resolution of exceptions.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management • Mentored junior analysts on trade settlement, reconciliation, and operational best practices, driving process efficiency and maintaining high standards of accuracy. • Demonstrated strong stakeholder management by effectively communicating with clients and successfully taking ownership of two additional processes, contributing to improved operational efficiency and service delivery.

2. Datamatics Business Solutions Limited - Tax Consultant • Worked on 100+ individual tax returns of Canada client (T1 Returns) within a 48-hour TAT, achieving 98% accuracy and full compliance using Tax Prep software. • Supported tax preparation teams during peak season by assisting with return reviews, resolving issues, and ensuring timely filings. • Assisted in tax planning and provided recommendations to maximize client benefits. Jan 2024 - April 2024

📜CERTIFICATIONS AND ACHIEVEMENTS

Secured 97 Marks in MS-CIT Exam. • Ranker of School in English Olympiad • Recognized with Value Recognition Award for resolving 95% of high-risk trade breaks within 24 hours, reducing settlement risk by 30% PROJECTS

A Study on Investment Myths and it's implication on the investment behaviour of young investors. • Conducted primary research to analyze the impact of behavioural biases and investment myths on young investors decision-making, deriving insights into investor psychology and financial literacy

💬 LANGUAGE

English, Hindi, Marathi

🛠 SKILLS

• Platforms and Tools :- DTCC, Safegui, Qwest, Intellimatch, Euroclear, NSCC, GSCC • Technical Skills:- Microsoft Excel(VLOOKUP, Concatenate, Pivot Table), Miscrosoft Word, Microsoft Powerpoint
